F001.notes: Content type definitions must move to shared core before lite implementation starts.

F002.notes: Use saved contents HTML fixtures for seiga and video.

F003.notes: Expected rows must include title, URL, IDs, contribution, thumbnail source, type, and no fixed 500-row cap.

F004.notes: SVG path rank detection is fragile and must be covered.

F005.notes: Both renderers should consume the same normalized result items.

F006.notes: Shared rank, type, search and sort semantics must match. Lite additionally applies F018 deletion visibility before shared operations.

F007.notes: Node upload and lite File API should enforce the same input validation expectations. Lite source-page links are the contents HTML/reward HTML buttons within their input panels; file inputs retain accessible names and descriptions.

F008.notes: Lite persisted history is optional and must be opt-in if added.

F009.notes: CSV column order and BOM behavior should stay stable.

F010.notes: Both viewers offer an unchecked include-header option for visible-row copy. Core fixtures and UI event tests cover on/off and empty copies; selected-item copy retains its existing header.

F011.notes: Node writes HTML; lite renders DOM. Result operations and selection controls must stay equivalent, with Lite-only deletion/restoration covered by F018.

F012.notes: Lite local thumbnail reuse depends on user-selected files or directories.

F013.notes: Lite remote thumbnail enrichment is best-effort because of CORS.

F014.notes: Lite must work from GitHub Pages without server endpoints.

F015.notes: History cards show total and missing counts without an excluded count. Parsed history snapshots remain unchanged by exclusion edits. Common exclusion keys survive history removal and apply to old and new analyses. history.test.js covers startup, migration and storage failures.

F016.notes: Node and lite should expose the same bookmarklet choices for saving source HTML files from nicokoken pages, including one click-copy/drag-register action, descriptive bookmark titles, load-more handling, and reward auto-scroll stop conditions. Generated-source behavior is exercised by test/compatibility/bookmarklet.test.js with virtual-clock page fixtures.

F017.notes: Both viewers must support visible-only selection, bulk selection controls, and selected-item clipboard copying without changing result schemas or history data.

F018.notes: history.test.js exercises common exclusions, latest-entry-only migration, authoritative empty lists, malformed/unreadable storage, history independence, key-only management and cross-tab refresh. Existing per-history deletedKeys is consulted only when creating an absent common list. Node omission is documented in CAPABILITY_EXCEPTIONS.md.

F019.notes: history.test.js exercises JSON downloads with exclusions enabled/disabled, keys absent from the result, malformed storage, full result reconstruction and export failures. The portable format is documented in docs/result-export.md.

F020.notes: result-file.test.js tests schema, identity, ranks, URL schemes, legacy fields and derived values. history.test.js exercises real exporter output through import UI events, confirmation choices, OR merging, cancellation, corrupt stores and write/rollback failures.
